_what: (agent-org#1600) The fixture project's host file: the machine facts the tool renders against. `projects[0].checkout` is the placeholder @@PROJECT@@, which a test replaces with the absolute path of a copy of this tree (the tool refuses a relative checkout); `units` is the declaration's `units` repeated for a reader that takes it from the host (the project declaration holds the one the tool reads today). Recorded, never a11ign's live file.

leadsHeader: The gh wrapper (packages/agent-org/host/gh) reads this: a workspace id on a line BY ITSELF below acts as
a11ign-ai-leads (write, not admin; its own GraphQL pool). Every other agent workspace gets
a11ign-ai-workers, and NO agent workspace acts as the human account. Comment lines never match an id.
Installed by `pnpm run host:install` to ~/leads/workspaces.txt; `pnpm run host:check` reports DIVERGED
when the installed copy differs. Chairman's identity ruling, 2026-09-24 (#1950, #2332, #2333).
